name: Elimelech
overview: Elimelech is introduced in Scripture as the husband of Naomi and father to Mahlon and Chilion, who together emigrated from Bethlehem in Judah to Moab during a time of famine. His death in Moab left Naomi a widow with two sons, setting the stage for the unfolding story of redemption through their family line. The land and inheritance of Elimelech later become central to Boaz's role as a kinsman-redeemer, highlighting Elimelech's lasting significance within God's providential plan as recorded in the book of Ruth.
